question: Why cannot we write the chemical formula of a compound formed by chlorine and sodium as CINa instead of NaCl?

options.text: The rule is to write the name of the metal first.
Chlorine is lighter, hence is written at the end.

solution:
The correct answer is __**The rule is to write the name of the metal first**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The chemical formula of a compound is written following specific conventions and rules.
 
• One of the rules is to write the symbol of the metal first, followed by the symbol of the non-metal.</li
